scope: Browser interactions previously listed as unverified. Headless Chromium only. Audible fades and ducking during live playback are still not measured.

checks.name: dragging the title on the canvas while viewing a format writes a format-only override by the dragged fraction of that format's frame; the master position is untouched
"hide in this format" hides the clip there only; "clear override" removes the override
with snapping on, a clip dropped near a beat lands exactly on it; with snapping off the same drag lands on a plain frame
"add beat at playhead" and "remove nearest beat" change the stored beat grid and mark it as corrected by hand
while the drum loop plays, the meter shows a real level (above -40 dB and not above 0)
"export all formats" lists one job per format and each finishes with a download of the right size
Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V pastes a full copy at the playhead (same source, trim and length) and selects it; Ctrl+D duplicates the selection right after itself

while a format is viewed, the Inspector scale slider writes a format-only override (master unchanged), keyframe buttons are disabled, and "reset to master" removes the override; back on the master the controls edit the master again

while a format is viewed, editing the title text changes the wording in that format only: the rendered frame of that format changes, the master and another format render byte-identically, the field shows each wording in its own view, and "back to the master text" restores it
effect keyframes in the editor: the ◆ button sets a key at the playhead; moving the playhead and changing the slider adds a second key 20 frames later instead of changing the static value
cut then paste moves the clip in one transaction (effects and keyframes come along); nothing is committed by the cut itself; one undo puts it back
Sound tab: typing a level writes a volume key at the playhead; between two keys the field shows the interpolated level (0.85 halfway between 0.5 and 1.2); "remove this key" removes only that key

volume line: the key is drawn at its frame; dragging it changes time and level in one edit (30→40, 0.5→1.5); a double-click on the line adds a key at the level there; arrow keys nudge the focused key without moving the playhead; Delete removes the key, not the clip; the key is named for assistive technology; a drag on the line moves the clip

volume line: S on a key makes the stretch to the next key smooth (the level a quarter of the way is 0.609, not the straight line's 0.675); Alt + drag draws the level — one edit replaces the keys under the stroke with keys along it (from frame 110 at 1.2 down to 170 at about 0.4), the earlier keys stay
Sound tab: "end the music with the picture" trims the music to the last detected beat before the picture ends and gives it a fade-out, in one transaction; undo restores it

markers: M adds one at the playhead; name (Hebrew + Latin) and colour are committed edits; a marker added by an agent appears; Shift+M / Alt+M jump between them; remove and undo work; the timeline query lists both
shuttle: K stops it and the frame holds

shuttle: L plays, L again goes to 2× (indicator shown, measured speed about 2×); J goes backwards at 1× and J again at 2×; Space stops and the frame holds; shuttling backwards stops at the first frame
a project change by another participant during playback does not stop it (normal speed and 2× shuttle both continue at their speed); a change while paused does not start it

multi-select: Ctrl+click adds a clip to the selection; dragging one moves both by the same 20 frames in one transaction and a third clip stays; Alt+→ nudges both; Ctrl+A selects all, Shift+click removes one; Delete removes the two selected in one transaction and one undo restores them

marquee: dragging a box over empty timeline space selects exactly the clips it touches (live while dragging); Shift+drag adds to the selection; Escape during a drag restores the selection from before it; a plain click on empty space clears it; none of this changes the project

a Hebrew subtitle file saved as Windows-1255 is imported with its Hebrew text intact and the editor says it had to guess the encoding; a UTF-16 file with a byte-order mark is imported too, without that note
download the project archive in the editor, import it back, and the editor opens a new project with the same content
no uncaught errors in the page during these interactions

a clip is removed from the timeline in one step three ways: the action bar above the tracks (disabled until a clip is selected), the right-click menu (opens with the keyboard focus inside and closes after use), and a button in the clip panel; undo brings it back

♪ on the blur radius (music with detected beats under the clip): it is named "פעימה על <label>", turning it on commits set_effect_modulator (every second beat) and opens its fieldset; choosing every 4 commits that; one undo takes back the change, a second the modulator, and the clip is as before

date stamp: its text field reads left to right; typed text is committed on Enter; letters are refused by the op and the refusal is shown under the field in Hebrew (the field marked invalid, the stored text kept); "תאריך היום" commits today as 'YY M D and the refusal goes

checks.name: time effect first: echo added after two effects is placed first; a separator (role separator, named by the rule) closes its row; moving the next effect up and the echo down are aria-disabled and change nothing; the cost line counts its pictures; a second time effect is refused and the refusal is shown in the panel in Hebrew

separator.name: אפקט זמן תמיד ראשון; האפקטים שאחריו חלים על התמונה הממוזגת

detail.cost: תמונות לכל פריים (בווידאו כל אחת מפוענחת בנפרד): 4
detail.panelRefusal: הפעולה אינה מתאימה לפריט הזה: לקליפ יכול להיות אפקט זמן אחד בלבד (הד, פיצול זמן, צמצם או קפיצות פריים)

checks.name: no uncaught errors in the page with the visual-wave controls

tracking, keyboard only: the "new point" button opens the picker with the focus on the picture; ten Shift+→ and five ↓ move the pick 100 and 5 frame pixels from the centre, announced in Hebrew; Enter commits create_motion_track at the SOURCE frame the playhead shows (60 at timeline frame 30, speed 2); the focus goes back and the panel says so

detail.said: נקודה ב־58% מהרוחב וב־51% מהגובה, פריים מקור 60
detail.status: נוצר מסלול מעקב. אפשר להתחיל במעקב.

checks.name: tracking, box drag: dragging over the disc picks an area; confirming commits a region track whose centre and size are the dragged box in 1/10000 of the picture (within 2 frame pixels), on source frame 60
tracking, progress and Stop: "Track" starts the job; the role=progressbar rises (aria-valuenow), its value text is the stage in Hebrew; "Stop" ends it canceled and nothing is attached

tracking, follow: after tracking the area, "attach without a jump" on a magenta title commits set_clip_follow with an offset that keeps it where it was: its centre on the still of the same frame moves at most 1 px

tracking, handle drag on a follower: dragging its move handle by 40×30 screen px changes its own offset by that fraction of the frame and moves it on the still by 40/k × 30/k frame px (within 2 px); it still follows
tracking, preview: the follower's centre in the editor preview is within 2 px of the still of the same frame (one evaluator); no page errors
adjustment layers: the timeline's add-track button adds an FX track in one transaction, shown as an adjustment track («התאמה»)

"apply to: the whole edit" (Look panel): exactly 1 transaction containing add_adjustment over the whole edit with the effect on it, the clip itself untouched; a second effect joins the same layer (add_effect)

an adjustment clip's inspector offers its opacity (no place, size or turn), the Look panel and the mask; moving the opacity commits one opacity-only change (set_clip_transform; nothing else on the clip changes)
"cover the whole edit" stretches the layer to the new end of the edit (frame 120) in one transaction of trim_clip
"Replace media…" commits replace_clip_media: the same clip id, place and length, now showing the chosen file
the Templates drawer lists 8 cards: the 6 built-ins, available, then Text-Behind-Subject and 3D-Zoom, unavailable with their Hebrew reason (template.unavailable.<model>)

cards.reason: דורשת מודל שמפריד את הדמות מהרקע בכל פריים, והוא אינו מותקן במחשב הזה. תבנית לעולם אינה מורידה מודלים.
דורשת מודל שמעריך עומק (כמה רחוקה כל נקודה מהמצלמה), והוא אינו מותקן במחשב הזה. תבנית לעולם אינה מורידה מודלים.

checks.name: a genre chip is an aria-pressed toggle that narrows the cards to its kind and, pressed again, shows them all

keyboard only, in Hebrew: a card opens the template dialog (focus inside), Escape closes it and the focus is back on the card; then pick → leave the video out and move a picture earlier → music → a Hebrew text (its counter counts it) → plan (a polite live region, nothing blocking) → Use adds exactly 1 revision (apply_template) with that text on a title, and the post-apply bar appears

beats.method: spectral-flux onsets + dynamic-programming beat tracking (no model); assumes a steady pulse; no regular bar accent found

checks.name: Shuffle on the post-apply bar (regenerate with the next seed, shuffled) adds exactly 1 revision
undo restores an equal creativeProjection: once after Shuffle (the applied template), once more after Use (the project before the template)
Welcome (an empty project) offers «התחל מתבנית», which opens the Templates drawer with the focus on its first card
no uncaught errors in the page with the adjustment and template controls

trend pack: from the keyboard, Space on "נעילה לפעימה" and ArrowDown on the velocity choice set the beat lock and ×2, each in one transaction and one undo step (Undo with Enter takes back ×2, then the lock); the Hebrew status line is a live region the checkbox points to, saying where the beat is (the model's frame); ×3 is disabled and says what it needs
